title: Yeasty Yellow Spanish Peppers Crema Catalana
description: A yeasty and snappy Spanish dish featuring roasted yellow peppers, perfect for a solo dinner, this ovo-vegetarian friendly crema catalana is a twist on the traditional dessert.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium high heat.
Roast the yellow peppers on the grill until the skin is blistered and charred.
Peel the peppers and puree them in a blender or food processor.
In a small bowl, proof the yeast by mixing it with 1 tablespoon of sugar and 1 tablespoon of warm water.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, cream, salt, black pepper, and lemon zest.
Add the yeast mixture and pepper puree to the egg mixture and whisk until smooth.
Pour the mixture into 4 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Dot the top of each ramekin with butter.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375 degrees for 25 minutes, or until set.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving.
